about: Models recommended for the Assistant, which plans work and dispatches tasks rather than writing code. Matched by model id against the models the runtime lists. Evidence: WorkflowArena (arXiv 2611.12856, 2026-11-09), Table 1. It is the closest public measure of planning and delegation (a model breaks work into tasks, hands them to worker processes and combines the results in one run); the Assistant instead starts and follows separate sessions, so the numbers support the choice without proving it.

assistant.label: default
assistant.evidence: Closest public evidence, WorkflowArena (planning and delegating in one run): 27.6% resolved at low effort (about $3.61 a task); low effort resolved more than medium or high, xhigh added 1.9 points.

assistant.label: stronger
assistant.evidence: Closest public evidence, WorkflowArena (planning and delegating in one run): 30.8% resolved at xhigh effort, about $29.26 a task.
